method: CUA native Safari and Chrome app controls. Three separate pressKey calls for a, b and c; browser reload, tab close/reopen, download and native file pickers. No page JavaScript injection or synthetic composition events.
initialState: Both main demos showed the original list showcase seed with Undo and Redo disabled. Existing user text was not replaced.
observedInBoth: Click first numbered item, Cmd+Left, five Right keys, then separate a/b/c keys. Item becomes Writeabc a first draft; ordered markers remain 3 and 4.
All changes saved was observed before reload. Cmd+R retains typed text.
One Cmd+Z after reload removes all three characters together, leaves Undo disabled and Redo enabled.
Wait for All changes saved, Cmd+W to close the test tab, Cmd+Shift+T to reopen it. Original item and enabled Redo survive.
Cmd+Shift+Z restores all three characters together at the same interior position.
Recover the Chrome-downloaded backup through the native file picker. A separate recovered editor contains typed text and reports Autosave is off.
Recovered-editor Undo removes all three characters, leaving the main editor's typed text unchanged. Recovered Redo restores all three characters.
Undo again in the recovered editor, then reload. The recovered editor is gone; the main editor still contains the saved typed text. Recovery did not overwrite main autosave.

backup.producer: Native Chrome Download session backup button
consumers: Native Chrome file picker and recovered editor
Native Safari file picker and recovered editor
backup.verification: Read-only JSON assertions against the actual downloaded file verified V6, list schema, one history entry with exactly three inserted runs and result offset/affinity. File bytes were hashed without modification.
backup.retention: Download retained; contains only the disposable seed and test input. It is not a backup of user-authored content.

uiInterruptions: Chrome address autocomplete initially opened the disposable clipboard route instead of the requested root. The explicit main-demo link navigated correctly before any persistence test began.

Safari native control pipe closed after a new tab and URL entry, before navigation. Rebinding showed the same tab on Start Page with the exact URL in the address field; Return completed navigation. No browser restart or repeated edit was performed.

inputSourceInspection.method: Read-only native System Settings Keyboard / Text Input / Edit inspection
inputSourceInspection.next: User subsequently approved temporary IME and VoiceOver testing. Attempts and verified restoration are recorded separately in 2026-10-04-list-native-assistive-input.json; this object describes the initial read-only inspection.

limits: One observed run per browser; not statistical reliability, crash recovery or physical-human certification.

This native persistence scenario covers interior typing in a numbered paragraph. Structural and formatted-history persistence have separate automated coverage; no additional native coverage is inferred.
